title: Nkwagyeɛ Ɔdansifoɔ a Ɔyɛ Den
intro: Ɔyɛ onipa a ɔwɔ boasetɔ kɛse ne gyidi a enhinhim, na ohyiraa mfe a enni ano maa ɔsoro asɛmpatrɛw adwuma, na ohyiaa animtiaabu ne pow a ennyae. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ gyidi ho adanse a tumi wom wɔ gyidi a wonni a ɛboro so anim, na ɛba awiei wɔ adeyɛ titiriw bi a ɛsan hyehyɛɛ wiase no mu.
clues: Mehyiraa m’asetena mu bere tenten a ɛyɛ nwonwa so frɛɛ me nkurɔfo sɛ wɔmmɛsom Allah.
Me nkurɔfo dii me ho fɛw na wɔbɔɔ me sobo sɛ madi mfomso a ɛda adi na mabɔ dam.
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ minsi biribi a ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ soronko mma me mpɔtam a ɛnyɛ asase no.
Kakraa bi pɛ na wogye dii na wɔkaa me ne m’abusua ho wɔ adansi soronko yi mu.
Mesoaa abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom biara mmienu mmienu wɔ hyɛn no mu, sɛdeɛ Allah kyerɛɛ no.
Nsuyiri kɛse bi kataa asase no so, gyee wɔn a wɔka me ho wɔ m’ahina mu nkutoo, bere a m’ankasa me babarima no sɛee esiane ne gyidi a onnye nni nti.

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
